item.title: US Tightens Visa Rules: Bangladeshi travellers required to pay $15,000 bond from January 21; Details inside
item.description: Starting Jan 21, Bangladeshi travellers to the US must pay up to $15,000 bond for B1/B2 visas. What does this mean for tourists and business visitors? Why is the US imposing this new rule? Find out the key details and implications.

item.title: Western disturbances to bring rain and snow again; IMD issues fresh alert
item.description: As snowfall continues in the hill states, minimum temperatures have slightly increased across the plains, offering temporary relief from severe cold. According to India Meteorological Department, multiple western disturbances will affect North India over the next seven days, bringing rain to plains and fresh snowfall in higher reaches.

item.title: Silver soars, Gold gains for second straight day amid market uncertainty; Check price here
item.description: Gold and silver prices continued their upward momentum as global trade tensions fueled safe-haven buying. Gold gained for the second consecutive day, while silver surged sharply, rising ₹45,100 per kg in nine days.

item.title: Magh Mela Snan Date 2026: When is the next major holy bath after Mauni Amavasya?
item.description: The Magh Mela 2026 is underway in Prayagraj, drawing lakhs of devotees to the sacred Triveni Sangam. After Paush Purnima, Makar Sankranti, and Mauni Amavasya, the next major holy bath will take place on Vasant Panchami, January 23, 2026.

item.title: Karnataka DGP Ramachandra Rao suspended after alleged obscene office video goes viral
item.description: A major controversy has erupted in Karnataka after a senior DGP-rank officer, Ramachandra Rao, was suspended following the circulation of an alleged obscene video reportedly recorded inside his office. The issue reached Chief Minister Siddaramaiah, who sought a detailed report and expressed strong displeasure.

item.title: Akshay Kumar and Twinkle Khanna escapes unhurt as Mercedes hits Auto in Juhu; Full details
item.description: Bollywood actor Akshay Kumar and his wife Twinkle Khanna had a narrow escape after a car from their convoy met with an accident in Mumbai’s Juhu area. A speeding Mercedes hit an auto-rickshaw, which then collided with a security vehicle in the convoy.

item.title: Stock Market Today: Sensex, Nifty open marginally lower amid mixed global cues
item.description: Indian equity benchmarks opened marginally lower on Tuesday, tracking mixed global signals and rising geopolitical concerns. The BSE Sensex slipped below the 83,200 mark in early trade, while the NSE Nifty hovered around 25,550.

item.title: ‘We Will Respond With Unseen Power’: Israel PM Netanyahu’s stern message to Tehran
item.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has issued a strong warning to Iran, saying Israel will respond with unprecedented force if attacked. His remarks come amid escalating regional tensions, reports of a deadly crackdown on protests in Iran, and increased US military presence in the Middle East.

item.title: Top Indian shuttler announces sudden retirement; Cites physical limitations
item.description: Indian badminton legend Saina Nehwal has announced her retirement from competitive badminton, citing chronic knee injuries that made elite-level training impossible. The 2012 London Olympic bronze medallist last competed in the 2023 Singapore Open but had already stopped playing two years ago.
